text:
nina: Opening this thread for coordination. I split the old `snippets/` folder into language-specific folders (snippets/python, snippets/js, snippets/go) and opened 5 PRs across docs that reference those snippets. We need a merge plan to avoid broken embeds and cross-language examples failing.

ryan: Can you list the PR numbers and which pages they touch?

nina: Yes:
- PR #7501: move snippets -> snippets/python + update python quickstart
- PR #7502: move snippets -> snippets/js + update js quickstart
- PR #7503: move snippets -> snippets/go + update go quickstart
- PR #7504: update architecture guide to reference new snippet paths (cross-lang links)
- PR #7505: add Netlify redirect rules for old /snippets/* -> new language paths

jess: Main risk is the architecture guide (7504) referencing snippets in three places. If snippet moves land after 7504, its preview will show broken embeds.

infra-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #7501 (https://deploy-preview-7501--docs.redwood.dev)

ryan: Two options: 1) merge each language move + its quickstart first (7501, 7502, 7503), then merge 7504, then 7505; or 2) merge redirects (7505) first so old links keep resolving, then merge moves. Both have tradeoffs.

nina: Redirect-first is simpler for consumers but creates redirect targets pointing to paths that don't exist yet until moves land. Netlify will serve the redirect without validating targets; that means a user hitting old URL will be redirected to a 404 until moves land.

jess: We can reduce the window if we merge language moves in quick succession, then 7504, then 7505. I prefer moves-first in a single merge window.

ryan: Agreed. Let's do a controlled window. Also, CI previews sometimes don't include _redirects unless the netlify plugin runs; PR 7505 should include a small env flag tweak so previews exercise redirects. I've put that in a follow-up commit.

nina: CI shows PR #7501 preview errors: "Embed not found: snippets/setup.py" in python quickstart. That's expected until merge.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview: PR #7501 build failed (error: missing snippet).

jess: For reviewers: I'd like @ryan to review 7501 and 7502, @nina to review 7503 and 7504. Who can merge? We should appoint a single merger to avoid interleaving.

ryan: I can be merger for the window. What time works?

nina: Suggest 10:30 PT tomorrow (low traffic). We'll merge 7501, 7502, 7503, then 7504, then 7505. That way 7504's preview will be accurate after moves.

jess: Add a pre-merge checklist to each PR:
- docs-preview green
- run local link check: `npx linkinator https://deploy-preview-<PR>--docs.redwood.dev -c 10 -r 3`
- verify all code embeds render (quick spot)
- tag merger in PR body

ryan: I'll also run a smoke script after each merge to verify core anchors and example embeds. Here's the tiny script I'll run (curl + grep):
```bash
# smoke-check.sh
set -e
urls=(
  "https://docs.redwood.dev/en/migration/quickstart#authentication"
  "https://docs.redwood.dev/en/architecture#sdk-snippets"
  "https://docs.redwood.dev/en/quickstart/python#example"
)
for u in "${urls[@]}"; do
  echo "Checking $u"
  code=$(curl -s -L -o /tmp/page.html -w "%{http_code}" "$u")
  if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
    echo "FAIL: $u returned $code"
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! grep -q "id=\"sdk-snippets\"\|Client token" /tmp/page.html; then
    echo "FAIL: anchor/content missing on $u"
    exit 1
  fi
done
echo "SMOKE OK"
```

nina: Nice. Can you also capture the list of old -> new paths so we can sanity-check redirects in PR7505?

jess: Copying mapping here:
- /snippets/setup -> /snippets/python/setup
- /snippets/quickstart-js -> /snippets/js/quickstart
- /snippets/quickstart-go -> /snippets/go/quickstart

ryan: I'll merge in this order at 10:30 PT: 7501 -> 7502 -> 7503 -> run smoke-check -> 7504 -> 7505. If smoke-check fails, I'll pause and open an emergency rollback PR.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview: PR #7502 build is passing.

nina: One more operational note: update the PR templates to include `--no-redirects` local preview flag for contributors who want to test moved pages without Netlify redirects interfering. I'll add that to 7505 as a docs note.

jess: Also list of reviewers for each PR in the body to accelerate approvals. I'll add @ryan + @nina reviewers to the three move PRs.

ryan: All approvals in place. I'll be online at 10:30 PT. Ping me in this thread if anything changes. :rocket:
